body.name: reachable-fixing transition
body.construction: Write \(\zeta\Rightarrow_{\mathrm{fix}}\zeta'\) iff the least \(\varphi=(s,W,D,k)\in\mathcal F\) has \(W\in R\cap D\), \(\operatorname{dis}_D(W)\cap\operatorname{de}_D(W)=\{W\}\), and the labelled conditional margin \(m_{s,W}=\sum_{x_W}K_{s,D}\) has a ledger certificate expressing its numerator as a nonempty sum of branch-reachable admissible-cell probabilities and its inherited denominator as a product of earlier positive ledger entries. Move \(W\) from \(R\) to \(F\), replace \(K_{s,D}\) by the CADMG fixed kernel \(K_{s,D}/m_{s,W}\), register the sign-normalized reduced margin in \(\mathcal D_H^{\mathrm{fix}}\), delete exactly \(\varphi\), and generate only tokens whose vertex masks omit \(W\). The emitted object is the division circuit, its denominator, and that positivity certificate. The local obligations are the fixing-kernel identity after cross-multiplication modulo \(\mathcal J\) and the displayed sum-product factorization of \(m_{s,W}\).
